tasks.title: Advisory MCP cross-check over a SweepReport (injected seam)
acceptance_criteria: it queries only ORPHAN/ORPHAN_CLUSTER candidates via the injected callable, raises disagreement notes, never mutates the report
tests/harness/test_mcp_crosscheck_advisory.py passes and the prior wire_up oracles still pass
tasks.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only advisory cross-checker mcp_crosscheck(report, mcp_query) -> list[str] to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py that, for each static ORPHAN/ORPHAN_CLUSTER candidate in a SweepReport, consults an INJECTED MCP query callable and raises a human-triage disagreement note when the MCP reports inbound usages -- advisory only, never flipping a verdict, never gating, never calling a live service.

spec.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only advisory cross-checker mcp_crosscheck(report, mcp_query) -> list[str] to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py that, for each static ORPHAN/ORPHAN_CLUSTER candidate in a SweepReport, consults an INJECTED MCP query callable and raises a human-triage disagreement note when the MCP reports inbound usages -- advisory only, never flipping a verdict, never gating, never calling a live service.
functional_requirements: Add ONE new top-level function mcp_crosscheck(report, mcp_query) -> list[str].
report is a SweepReport. mcp_query is an injected callable taking a module rel-path str and returning an int count of inbound usages the MCP graph knows about (CALLS/IMPORTS/USAGE edges).
Iterate the candidate modules = list(report.orphan) + list(report.orphan_cluster), in that order (both are already sorted). Do NOT query report.wired or report.config_wired modules.

For each candidate m: call mcp_query(m); if it raises, skip that candidate (best-effort, never propagate). If the returned count is truthy (> 0), append a disagreement note string that contains the module rel-path and the count, e.g. f"{m}: static says orphan, MCP shows {count} inbound usages -> likely dynamic wiring, do not auto-remove".

Return the list of disagreement notes in deterministic order. Do NOT mutate report (its four class lists are unchanged). Do NOT write any file. Do NOT import or call any live MCP/network client -- the only external touch is the injected mcp_query callable.
Pure: stdlib only; no process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess.
spec.interfaces: mcp_crosscheck(report: SweepReport, mcp_query: Callable[[str], int]) -> list[str]  # advisory: for each ORPHAN/ORPHAN_CLUSTER candidate, query the injected mcp_query and emit a disagreement note when it reports inbound usages; never mutates the report, never gates. Lives in harness/wire_up.py beside the unchanged check_wired / discover_live_roots / sweep_modules / SweepReport seams.
edge_cases: mcp_query raising for a candidate must be swallowed (that candidate yields no note), never propagated.
A candidate whose mcp_query returns 0 (or a falsy value) yields no note.
report.wired and report.config_wired modules are never passed to mcp_query.
The function is deterministic: same report + same mcp_query behaviour -> identical note list.
report is never mutated -- report.to_dict() before and after the call is identical.
non_goals: No change to check_wired, discover_live_roots, sweep_modules, SweepReport, LIVE_ROOTS, WireResult, or _grep_config -- this leaf ADDS mcp_crosscheck only.
No live MCP/network/process/model call -- the MCP is reached ONLY through the injected mcp_query callable.
Never flip a verdict or gate a build -- the cross-check is advisory enrichment only.
No file writes; the runner/regression-guard handle persistence.

unit_tests: disagreement note raised for an MCP-inbound orphan, with the count surfaced
no note for a candidate the MCP agrees is unused
test_spec.test_data_requirements: A SweepReport constructed directly + a stub mcp_query callable supplied by the committed oracle (no live MCP).
